as_told.title: Rocket pioneers Tsiolkovsky and Oberth believed they were in touch with angelic beings

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says, passing on what a researcher named Diana Pasulka told him, that the men who started the big space programs all believed they were in contact with non-human beings: Jack Parsons, who founded the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, an American rocket lab, along with the Russian rocket pioneer Konstantin Tsiolkovsky and Germany's Wernher von Braun. If true, it would mean the space age was shaped by men who believed something other than humans was guiding them. In later episodes Michels tells it on his own, softening it to Parsons 'implying' such contact, and once naming the German rocket pioneer Hermann Oberth instead and calling the beings angelic.
